name: EN - Rob Dyrdek's Fantasy Factory (2009) (US)
plot: A crew of people come up with new things to do every week. One day, they may work on a business franchise. Another day, they might go and make someone ride a bull, or shoot burritos at people.
cast: Rob Dyrdek, Chris Pfaff, Scott Pfaff, Christopher Boykin, Sterling 'Steelo' Brim, Chanel West Coast
director: Rob Dyrdek, Jeff Tremaine, Shane Nickerson

name: EN - The Challenge (1998) (US)
plot: Each Challenge pits numerous cast members from past seasons of reality shows against each other, dividing them into two separate teams according to different criteria, such as gender, which show they first appeared on, whether or not they're veterans or rookies on the show, etc. The two teams compete in numerous missions in order to win prizes and advance in the overall game.
cast: T.J. Lavin, Johnny 'Bananas' Devenanzio, Nurys Mateo, Chris 'C.T.' Tamburello, Cara Maria Sorbello

name: EN - The Challenge UK (2023) (GB)
plot: 16 British reality TV stars compete against each other in a series of harsh trials. There's a £100,000 prize for the winner and a place in the World Championship.

name: EN - Hard Knocks (2001) (US)
plot: An inside look at NFL training camps. From the top coaches to the rookies trying to make the team, Hard Knocks showcases what it takes to be in the NFL.

name: EN - This Old House (1979) (US)
plot: TV's original home-improvement show, following one whole-house renovation over several episodes.
cast: Bob Vila, Kevin O'Connor, Richard Trethewey, Norm Abram, Tom Silva, Jenn Nawada, Mauro Henrique, Mark McCullough

name: EN - Beast Games (2024) (US)
plot: I gathered 1,000 people to fight for $5,000,000, the LARGEST cash prize in TV history! We're also giving away a private island, Lamborghinis, and millions more in cash throughout the competition! Go watch to see the greatest show ever made!
cast: Jimmy Donaldson, Chandler Hallow, Karl Jacobs, Nolan Hansen, Tareq Salameh, Mack Hopkins, Sean Klitzner
director: Jimmy Donaldson, Tyler Conklin, Sean Klitzner

name: EN - Married at First Sight UK (2015) (GB)
plot: Working with leading relationship experts, eight British singles are carefully match-made into four married couples, who each meet each other - for the very first time - at their wedding. We'll follow them as they marry, honeymoon, meet the in-laws and set up home, all the while getting to know one another more and more deeply, to see if the matchmakers have got it right and they will have a future together.
cast: Mel Schilling, Paul C Brunson, Charlene Douglas

name: EN - The Challenge: All Stars (2021) (US)
plot: Twenty-two of the most iconic, boldest, and fiercest Challenge All Stars from the original The Real World and Road Rules return for a second chance at the ultimate competition as they vie for their shot at the $500,000 grand prize. Follow the competitors as they face unprecedented, over-the-top challenges set in the Andes Mountains of Argentina.
director: Mary-Ellis Bunim, Mark Long, Johnathan Murray

name: EN - Squid Game: The Challenge
plot: Immersed in the world of "Squid Game," 456 real players put their skills — and character — to the ultimate test for a life-changing $4.56 million prize.
